mapper.select: SELECT DATE(upload_time) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(upload_time) ORDER BY period

SELECT YEARWEEK(upload_time, 1) AS yearWeek, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY YEARWEEK(upload_time, 1) ORDER BY yearWeek

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(upload_time, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(upload_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period
SELECT IFNULL(examine_dept, '未知') AS dept, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY examine_dept ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT IFNULL(examine_doctor, '未知') AS doctor, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY examine_doctor ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT IFNULL(${dimensionField}, '未知') AS dimension, DATE_FORMAT(${timeField}, #{timeFormat}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ct_examination WHERE is_invalid = 0 AND upload_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY ${dimensionField}, DATE_FORMAT(${timeField}, #{timeFormat}) ORDER BY dimension, period
